name: Gree Baaker
description: Gree Baaker was a planet in the Gree Baaker system of the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. Under the Galactic Empire, it was home to the Gree Baaker Labor Camp. Many of the camp's prisoners were transferred to work detail on the Death Star, and later perished with its destruction in 0 ABY.
lead_paragraphs: Gree Baaker was a planet in the Gree Baaker system of the Outer Rim's Atrivis sector. Under the Galactic Empire, it was home to the Gree Baaker Labor Camp. Many of the camp's prisoners were transferred to work detail on the Death Star, and later perished with its destruction in 0 ABY.
